pytorch-model-cli.source: Official reference installs torch 2.7.0 from the CPU index and NumPy; NumPy is pinned to the official verifier version. Cache contains public installers only.

kv-store-grpc.source: Package versions explicitly required by the public task instruction.

largest-eigenval.source: Public library version used by the official reference runtime; cache includes installers, no reference implementation.

chess-best-move.source: Exact public dependency pins from the official reference installation commands; no task solution is cached.

gcode-to-text.source: Exact public dependency pins from the official reference installation commands; OpenCV system dependencies are probed with the accepted public APT cache.

count-dataset-tokens.source: Public library versions used by the official reference runtime; dataset and tokenizer snapshots are provisioned separately.

pypi-server.source: Public package versions from the pinned task image and official reference installation commands. Installer archives contain no submitted vectorops package.
